name: Mini Hyrox loop
description: Short race-style rounds mixing rowing, carries, and lunges.
caution: Race-style rounds are intense. Pace yourself and stop if you feel dizzy or sharp pain.

name: Farmers carry ladder
description: Carry heavier weights across the room and back, one step up each round.

name: Ski erg intervals
description: Short hard efforts with rest between them.
caution: Ski erg intervals raise your heart rate quickly. Stop if you feel chest pain.

name: Wall ball flow
description: Fun wall ball rounds at a comfortable pace.

name: Sandbag lunge steady
description: Controlled lunges with a relaxed pace.

name: Burpee broad jump set
description: Short sets of burpee broad jumps with rest between sets.
caution: Jumping and floor drops load the joints. Stop if you feel sharp pain.

name: Easy row and carry
description: A light row followed by an easy carry.

name: Rowing sprints
description: Short sprint pulls with full recovery.

name: Race-day pacing
description: Practice a steady pace over a few rounds.

name: Mixed station circuit
description: Rotate through a few stations for variety.

name: Sled drag reset
description: Easy sled drags for an active break.

name: Lunge and carry finisher
caution: Keep your back neutral when carrying. Stop if you feel sharp pain.
